paper.title_en: Nanohertz gravitational waves from domain walls nucleated during inflation
paper.abstract_en: We investigate scalar-induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) produced by domain walls (DWs) nucleated via quantum tunneling during inflation with an extended nucleation time. In contrast to the small-period nucleation framework, in which DWs form over a narrow interval and possess nearly identical radii, we show that an extended nucleation period leads to a distribution of DW radii characterized by $γ\equiv\overline{R^{10}}/(\overline{R^5})^2>1$, which enhances the resulting curvature perturbations. We construct a two-field inflation model with an inflaton $φ$ and a spectator field $χ$ coupled through the potential $V(φ,χ)$, where the DW tension $σ(t)$ evolves smoothly as the inflaton rolls past a critical value. The characteristic width of this transition determines the cutoff scale $k_{\text{cut}}$ of the curvature power spectrum, enabling the SIGW peak to be placed in the nanohertz frequency band with detectable amplitude. For three representative parameter sets, we compute the SIGW spectra and find that the peak frequency ranges from $\sim10^{-8}$\,Hz to $\sim10^{-1}$\,Hz, with the nanohertz-peaked spectrum matching the NANOGrav and EPTA signals for suitable parameter choices. By selecting different parameters, our model can produce signals detectable by different gravitational-wave detectors.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文构建双场暴胀模型，通过畴壁量子成核的延展成核时间放大曲率扰动，产生纳赫兹标量诱导引力波，并与NANOGrav/EPTA信号对应，理论构造具体、参数预测明确，值得通读以评估其机制与观测匹配的严谨性。
decision.title_zh: 暴胀期间成核的畴壁产生的纳赫兹引力波
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在暴胀期间通过量子隧穿成核、且成核时间延展的畴壁（DWs）所产生的标量诱导引力波（SIGWs）。与畴壁在狭窄区间内形成并具有几乎相同半径的短周期成核框架不同，我们表明延展的成核周期会导致畴壁半径的分布，其特征为 $\gamma\equiv\overline{R^{10}}/(\overline{R^5})^2>1$，这增强了由此产生的曲率扰动。我们构建了一个双场暴胀模型，其中包含暴胀子 $\phi$ 和一个旁观场 $\chi$，二者通过势 $V(\phi,\chi)$ 耦合，其中畴壁张力 $\sigma(t)$ 在暴胀子滚过临界值时平滑演化。该转变的特征宽度决定了曲率功率谱的截断尺度 $k_{\text{cut}}$，使得 SIGW 峰值能够被置于纳赫兹频段并具有可探测的幅度。对于三组代表性参数集，我们计算了 SIGW 谱，发现峰值频率范围从 $\sim10^{-8}\,$Hz 到 $\sim10^{-1}\,$Hz，并且在合适的参数选择下，峰值位于纳赫兹的谱与 NANOGrav 和 EPTA 信号相匹配。通过选择不同的参数，我们的模型可以产生可被不同引力波探测器探测到的信号。
